if: the Government has, on the recommendations of the Council, by NOTIFICATION specified a category of supply of goods or services or both
a supply falls in that notified category
then: the tax on it SHALL BE PAID ON REVERSE CHARGE BASIS BY THE RECIPIENT, and all the provisions of the Act apply to that recipient as if he were the person liable to pay the tax on that supply
note: An enabling provision. The Act names no category; the categories live in notifications that are not extracted here, so for any specific supply the reverse-charge status is UNKNOWN from this source. The registration status of the supplier is irrelevant under s.9(3) — that is s.9(4)'s test, not this one. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: The Government may, on the recommendations of the Council, by notification, specify categories of supply of goods or services or both, the tax on which shall be paid on reverse charge basis by the recipient of such goods or services or both and all the provisions of this Act shall apply to such recipient as if he is the person liable for paying the tax in relation to the supply of such goods or services or both.
